text-repeater.quickAnswer: Repeats any text as many times as you want — from once to 100,000 times — with your choice of separator (new line, space, comma or none). Live total-character count, automatic safety cap at 1,000,000 characters, and one-click copy or .txt download. Handy for placeholder text, test data and decorative dividers.

Output: "ha" + "\n" + "ha" + "\n" + "ha"
